overview.title: Stock
overview.description: What is in the store right now, and what is about to run out.
overview.loadFailed: We could not load the stock. Check your connection and try again.

lowStock.title: Running low
lowStock.countDescription: {{total}} products across the whole catalogue are at or below the minimum somebody set for them.
lowStock.noneDescription: No product is at or below its minimum. Nothing needs ordering on this count.
lowStock.seeAll: Show only these in the table
lowStock.caption: Products at or below their minimum, with the store holding them, what is left and the minimum.
lowStock.emptyBody: Every counted product is above the minimum set for it. Set a minimum on a product to be warned about it here.

valuation.title: What the stock is worth
valuation.description: Every counted product still on hand, valued at what the cooperative paid for it.
valuation.estimatedNote: {{total}} of these figures rest on a list price rather than on a receipt, because nothing costed has ever been received for them.
valuation.allCosted: Every figure here rests on a receipt the cooperative actually paid.

filters.lowOnlyHint: Products at or below the minimum set for them.
filters.inStockOnlyHint: Leaves out the rows sitting at zero, which is most of a long catalogue.

stock.caption: What each store holds, with the product, the quantity and the minimum set for it.
stock.emptyTitle: Nothing is in the store yet
stock.emptyBody: Record what the cooperative has received and it appears here with the store holding it.
stock.emptyFilteredBody: Choose another store or category, or clear the filters to see everything the cooperative holds.

movementFields.productPlaceholder: Search by name or product code
movementFields.productClear: Remove the product from this movement
movementFields.quantityHint: Digits only. Three decimal places at most.
movementFields.quantityHintUnit: In {{unit}}. Three decimal places at most, for example 400.500.
movementFields.unitCost: Cost of one unit in RWF
movementFields.unitCostHint: Leave empty when no price has been agreed yet, which is usual for a member's delivery.
movementFields.occurredAtHint: Today, unless the stock moved on another day.
movementFields.memberHint: Leave empty unless one member brought this in. Naming them puts the delivery on their record.
movementFields.memberPlaceholder: Search by name, member code or phone number
movementFields.memberClear: Remove the member from this movement
movementFields.noteHint: One line the office will still understand next year, for example: weighbridge ticket 118.
movementFields.expenseCategory: Post the cost as an expense

receiveDialog.title: Receive stock into a store
receiveDialog.description: Stock arriving at the cooperative. The store's level goes up as soon as it is recorded.
receiveDialog.done: {{quantity}} of {{product}} was received as {{reference}}. The store now holds {{level}}.
receiveDialog.expenseIntro: Where the cooperative paid on receipt, name the expense category and the cost is posted to the books in the same step. Leave it alone and the stock simply arrives.

receiveErrors.quantity: Write a quantity greater than zero, using digits only, with at most three decimal places.
receiveErrors.unitCost: Write what one unit cost, using digits only, with at most two decimal places. A cost is needed to post an expense.
receiveErrors.occurredAt: Write the date as a real date.
receiveErrors.expenseCategoryId: Choose the expense category the cost belongs to.

issueDialog.title: Issue stock out of a store
issueDialog.description: Stock leaving the cooperative for any reason other than a sale. The store's level goes down as soon as it is recorded.
issueDialog.done: {{quantity}} of {{product}} was issued as {{reference}}. The store now holds {{level}}.
issueDialog.notEnoughTitle: There is not that much in the store
issueDialog.notEnoughNow: We have read the level again: {{warehouse}} holds {{level}}. Issue that much or less, or correct the count first if the store really holds more.
issueDialog.notEnoughUnknown: Issue less than you asked for, or correct the count first if the store really holds more.

issueErrors.quantity: Write a quantity greater than zero, using digits only, with at most three decimal places.
issueErrors.occurredAt: Write the date as a real date.

adjustDialog.title: Correct a count
adjustDialog.description: For when a count in the store disagrees with the record. Write what you counted and the correction is worked out for you.
adjustDialog.countedHint: The quantity you found in the store, not the difference. Zero is a real count.
adjustDialog.countedHintUnit: The quantity you found, in {{unit}} — not the difference. Zero is a real count.
adjustDialog.reasonHint: One line, for example: two sacks spoiled by rain and were not recorded.
adjustDialog.restate: This records that {{counted}} of {{product}} was counted in the store. The correction up or down is worked out from the record.
adjustDialog.done: The count of {{product}} was recorded as {{reference}}. The store now holds {{level}}.

adjustErrors.countedQuantity: Write what you counted, using digits only, with at most three decimal places. Zero is allowed.
adjustErrors.reason: Say why the record was wrong. A correction with no reason cannot be accounted for later.
adjustErrors.occurredAt: Write the date as a real date.

transferDialog.title: Move stock between stores
transferDialog.description: Stock moving from one of the cooperative's stores to another. Two movements are written, one out and one in.
transferDialog.toPlaceholder: Choose the store it is going to
transferDialog.sameAsSource: {{name}} — it is already leaving this store
transferDialog.sameStore: Choose a different store. Moving stock into the store it is leaving would move nothing.
transferDialog.done: {{quantity}} of {{product}} was moved. It left as {{outReference}} and arrived as {{inReference}}.

transferErrors.quantity: Write a quantity greater than zero, using digits only, with at most three decimal places.
transferErrors.occurredAt: Write the date as a real date.

movements.title: Movement history
movements.description: Every movement of stock the cooperative has recorded, newest first.
movements.caption: Movements of stock, with the reference, the date, the kind, the product, the store and the quantity.
movements.searchPlaceholder: Reference, product name or product code
movements.loadFailed: We could not load the history. Check your connection and try again.
movements.totalsCover: These two cover every page of the current filters, added across all units.
movements.emptyBody: Receive the first stock into a store and it appears here with its own reference.
movements.emptyFilteredBody: Widen the dates, or clear the filters to see the whole history.

reverse.title: Write a correction for this movement?
reverse.consequence: The movement stays in the history, and an opposite movement is written beside it so the store's level returns to what it was. Nothing is removed.
reverse.transferWarning: This movement is half of a move between two stores. Both halves are corrected together, because undoing one alone would leave stock recorded in a store it never reached.
reverse.reasonHint: One line, for example: recorded twice by mistake.
reverse.reasonRequired: Say why this movement is being corrected.
reverse.donePair: {{reference}} was corrected on both sides of the move. The corrections are {{first}} and {{second}}.

products.title: Products
products.description: What the cooperative deals in. A product is never deleted, only retired.
products.caption: The catalogue, with the code, both names, the category, the unit, what is on hand and the minimum.
products.loadFailed: We could not load the catalogue. Check your connection and try again.
products.retireConsequence: The product stops being offered when stock is received, issued or sold, and every movement already recorded against it stays exactly as it is. It can be put back in service at any time. Nothing is deleted.
products.restoreConsequence: It is offered again when stock is received, issued or sold.
products.emptyBody: Add what the cooperative deals in, and stock can be received against it.
products.emptyFilteredBody: Choose another category or kind, or clear the filters to see the whole catalogue.

productDialog.addDescription: Something the cooperative buys, holds or sells. The unit chosen here is the unit every quantity will be recorded in.
productDialog.editDescription: The code and the names can always change. The unit and whether it is counted cannot, once stock has moved.
productDialog.unitFrozen: The unit cannot change: stock has already moved in this unit, and changing it would restate every quantity already recorded.
productDialog.countingFrozen: Whether this product is counted cannot change: stock has already moved, and turning counting off would abandon its level with no movement to say where it went.
productDialog.typeFixed: A product stays goods or a service for good.
productDialog.serviceNotCounted: A service is not held in a store, so it is never counted.

productFields.name: Name
productFields.nameHint: What the office calls it, for example: Maize grain.
productFields.nameRwHint: Shown to anybody reading the system in Kinyarwanda. Leave it empty to use the name above.
productFields.skuHint: Left empty, a code is made from the name.
productFields.unitHint: Every quantity of this product is recorded in this unit, so choose it before the first delivery.
productFields.typeHint: Goods are held in a store. A service is not.
productFields.tracked: Count this product in the store
productFields.trackedHint: On for anything held in a store. Off for something the cooperative provides rather than holds.
productFields.minStockLevelHint: The level at which this product shows as running low. Leave it empty for no warning.
productFields.purchasePriceHint: Used to value stock the cooperative has never paid a recorded price for.
productFields.salePriceHint: Offered as the starting price on a sale.

productErrors.sku: A product code is forty characters at most.
productErrors.name: A name is needed.
productErrors.nameRw: That Kinyarwanda name is too long.
productErrors.categoryId: Choose a category, or leave it without one.
productErrors.unitId: Choose the unit this product is measured in.
productErrors.minStockLevel: Write the level using digits only, with at most three decimal places.
productErrors.defaultPurchasePrice: Write the price using digits only, with at most two decimal places.
productErrors.defaultSalePrice: Write the price using digits only, with at most two decimal places.

categories.title: Product categories
categories.description: How the catalogue is grouped. A category is never deleted, only put out of service.
categories.caption: Product categories, with the Kinyarwanda name, how many products are in each and whether it is in service.
categories.formDescription: A group the catalogue is sorted by. Grouping goes one level deep.
categories.emptyBody: A category is optional, and it is what makes a long catalogue readable.

categoryFields.name: Name
categoryFields.nameRwHint: Shown to anybody reading the system in Kinyarwanda.
categoryFields.parentHint: Leave it empty for a category of its own. Grouping goes one level deep only.

warehouses.title: Stores
warehouses.description: Where the cooperative keeps what it holds. A store is never deleted, only closed.
warehouses.caption: The cooperative's stores, with the code, the place, what each holds and which one is the default.
warehouses.loadFailed: We could not load the stores. Check your connection and try again.
warehouses.showClosedHint: A closed store takes no new stock, and keeps every movement already recorded against it.
warehouses.closeConsequence: The store takes no new stock, and every movement already recorded against it stays exactly as it is. It can be opened again at any time.
warehouses.closeHoldsStock: This store is holding {{total}} products. A store holding stock cannot be closed: move what is in it to another store first, and then close it.
warehouses.reopenConsequence: The store takes new stock again, and it can be chosen when stock is received or moved.
warehouses.defaultMoved: {{name}} is now the default store. Stock arrives there unless another store is chosen.
warehouses.emptyBody: Stock has to arrive somewhere. Add the cooperative's first store and it becomes the default.

warehouseDialog.addDescription: A place the cooperative keeps stock. It can be a warehouse, a collection point or a room at the office.
warehouseDialog.editDescription: The name, the code and the place can always change.
warehouseDialog.firstIsDefault: This is the cooperative's first store, so it becomes the default whatever is chosen below. Stock has to arrive somewhere.
warehouseDialog.firstIsDefaultShort: The first store is always the default.
warehouseDialog.alreadyDefault: This is already the default store. A cooperative always keeps exactly one, so make another store the default instead of clearing this one.

warehouseFields.name: Name
warehouseFields.nameHint: What the staff call it, for example: Store at the Huye office.
warehouseFields.codeHint: Left empty, a code is made from the name.
warehouseFields.isDefaultHint: Stock arrives here unless another store is chosen. Turning this on moves the flag off whichever store holds it.

warehouseErrors.name: A name is needed.
warehouseErrors.code: A store code is twenty characters at most.
warehouseErrors.district: That district name is too long.
warehouseErrors.sector: That sector name is too long.

units.title: Units of measure
units.description: What the cooperative measures in. Nothing here assumes kilograms.
units.caption: Units of measure, with the symbol, both names, the decimal places and how many products use each.
units.loadFailed: We could not load the units. Check your connection and try again.
units.showInactiveHint: A unit out of service is not offered on new products, and keeps every product already measured in it.
units.sharedNoEdit: Shared by every cooperative, so it cannot be renamed here
units.emptyBody: A product cannot be added until there is a unit to measure it in.

unitDialog.addDescription: A unit this cooperative measures in. Sacks, litres, bunches and days of hire are all units.
unitDialog.editDescription: The names and the symbol can change. The key and the decimal places cannot.
unitDialog.keyFixed: The key cannot change: paper and reports already refer to it.
unitDialog.precisionFixed: The decimal places cannot change: every quantity already recorded in this unit was rounded to them.

unitFields.keyHint: Upper case letters, digits and underscores, for example SACK_50KG. It is how the unit is referred to in reports.
unitFields.symbolHint: The short form shown beside every quantity, for example kg.
unitFields.precisionHint: How finely this unit is measured. A sack is counted whole; a weight is not.
unitFields.factorHint: For example, a tonne is 1000 of a kilogram.

unitErrors.key: A key is upper case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
unitErrors.symbol: A symbol is needed, twelve characters at most.
unitErrors.precision: Choose how finely this unit is measured.
unitErrors.baseUnitId: Choose the unit this one is built on, or none.
unitErrors.factorToBase: Say how many of the other unit this one is.

apiErrors.insufficientStock: There is not that much in the store. We have read the level again below.
apiErrors.countAgrees: The count agrees with the record, so there is nothing to correct.
apiErrors.alreadyReversed: That movement has already been corrected.
apiErrors.isAReversal: That movement is itself a correction, so it cannot be corrected again. Correct the movement it points at instead.
apiErrors.productRetired: That product has been retired, so stock cannot move against it. Put it back in service first.
apiErrors.productNotCounted: That product is not counted in a store, so stock cannot move against it.
apiErrors.warehouseClosed: That store is closed, so stock cannot move into or out of it. Open it again first.
apiErrors.systemUnit: That unit is shared by every cooperative, so it cannot be renamed here. Add your own unit instead.
apiErrors.unitKeyTaken: A unit with that key already exists.
apiErrors.unitFrozen: The unit cannot change: stock has already moved in it, and changing it would restate every quantity already recorded.
apiErrors.countingFrozen: Whether this product is counted cannot change: stock has already moved against it.
apiErrors.skuTaken: A product with that code already exists.
apiErrors.categoryTooDeep: Grouping goes one level deep. Choose a category that is not itself inside another one.
apiErrors.categoryNameTaken: A category with that name already exists.
apiErrors.warehouseIsDefault: This is the default store, and a cooperative always keeps exactly one. Make another store the default and this one is freed.
apiErrors.warehouseHoldsStock: This store is still holding stock, so it cannot be closed. Move what is in it to another store first.
apiErrors.warehouseCodeTaken: A store with that code already exists.
